manufacturerIndications.summary: In conditions of anaemia, loss of appetite, convalescence, especially after debilitating fevers or surgical operations, pregnancy, loss of weight and in growing children. MODE OF ACTION Feeling of exhaustion and anxiety due to overwork and worry rapidly subside and general physical improvement in the patient very shortly appears....
